answer.reason: Only the offering of the seventh day is a deed of this Elishama; the other verses give his command, which the summary already states, or a genealogy.

clauses.english: made his offering of silver, gold, flour and animals on the seventh day
clauses.quote: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud

doubts: 1CH 7:26 is a genealogy of Ephraim, probably an ancestor of the same name, so I left it out.
